entities.name: Remote UE Report procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by a UE acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay to notify the network about connection or disconnection of a remote UE.

entities.name: ProSe UE-to-network relay
entities.description: UE acting as a relay between remote UE and network.

entities.name: Remote UE
entities.description: UE that connects to or disconnects from the ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: Remote UE connected
entities.description: Condition where remote UE is connected to the ProSe UE-to-network relay.

entities.name: Remote UE disconnected
entities.description: Condition where remote UE is disconnected from the ProSe UE-to-network relay.

relations.description: Procedure is performed by the ProSe UE-to-network relay.
Procedure notifies network about remote UE status.
Procedure notifies network when remote UE is connected.
Procedure notifies network when remote UE is disconnected.
